description: Na₅SrTaP₄ is alpha Pu-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Ta and five P atoms. The Na-Ta bond length is 3.28 Å. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 3.02-3.32 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to five P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.30 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.10 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.03 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four P atoms to form distorted NaP₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent TaNaP₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaP₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one TaNaP₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.09 Å. Sr is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five P atoms. There are a spread of Sr-P bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.23 Å. Ta is bonded to one Na and four P atoms to form TaNaP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaP₄ trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one NaP₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Ta-P bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.41 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Sr, and one Ta atom. In the second P site, P is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to five Na, two equivalent Sr, and one Ta atom. In the third P site, P is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six Na, one Sr, and one Ta atom. In the fourth P site, P is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six Na, one Sr, and one Ta atom.
